context:
Goal: new lanes stop printing old warnings, and an orchestrator starts its lanes without you clicking.
Problem (goal): both steps are ready with no lane. cloud-snapshot-age-check: a stale snapshot makes every new lane print old warnings and run old hooks (31 lanes printed the old EXECPATH line); PR #1363 passed round 3 and was held, then went back to ready on Nov 12. c107: your Oct 26 gripe that the degen orchestrator on the Mac needed you to accept each started session; the cloud cannot reach the Mac, so a probe has to run there. A local lane start needs your click.
Based on (read): the two step notes; ruling lanes-start-as-agents (item 168 a) keeps one press per Mac lane start.
Departs from: main — neither step has a lane; a starts one, b starts two, c closes both.
Meanwhile: nothing else waits on this.

options.gain: Lanes stop printing stale warnings; nothing waits on a click.
options.how: A lane builds step cloud-snapshot-age-check (warn once on a cloud start when the snapshot still holds an old startup entry). c107 is dropped for now: a local lane start needs your click.
options.label: Start the snapshot check now; drop c107 until you can press on the Mac (recommended)
options.lose: An orchestrator on your Mac still needs one press per lane start.

options.how: A lane builds the snapshot check, and a second lane writes the Mac probe as one paste-ready prompt for you.
options.label: Start both
options.lose: c107 needs you to run a probe on the Mac, and the cloud cannot reach it.

options.gain: Two fewer things in the queue.
options.how: Both steps are closed as not worth building now.
options.label: Drop both
options.lose: Stale warnings in every new lane, and the click per lane start, stay.
